title: The Cartier complement over its generic DVR stalk
statement: Let N be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], V an open of N, D an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], and j:D -> N an effective Cartier centre [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal]. Assume z belongs to V exactly when z is not in the range of j. Let eta be a generic point of D. Assume R = O_(N,j(eta)) is a domain discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], and put K = FractionRing R. There is t:Spec K -> V making the square with Spec(algebraMap R K):Spec K -> Spec R, V -> N, and the canonical Spec R -> N a pullback [def-pc-fibre-product]. No torsor, group, finite cover, or normalization occurs.

proof.text: Pull the invertible Cartier ideal back along the flat canonical morphism Spec R -> N (Scheme.flat_fromSpecStalk and IsInvertible.comap_of_flat). A Cartier chart containing the closed point of the local spectrum is the whole spectrum (IsLocalRing.closedPoint_mem_iff). Thus the pulled ideal is generated on Spec R by a nonzero global section. By support_comap and range_subschemeι its support is the inverse image of the centre. The generator excludes the zero prime; every nonzero prime of the DVR is its maximal ideal. The closed point belongs to the inverse image since fromSpecStalk sends it to j(eta). This proves that the inverse image of the centre consists exactly of the closed point, without using integrality or genericity of D.

Choose an irreducible uniformizer. Every nonzero DVR element is associated to a power of it (IsDiscreteValuationRing.associated_pow_irreducible). IsLocalization.iff_of_le_of_exists_dvd therefore gives IsLocalization.Away for the fraction field. IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization makes Spec K -> Spec R an open immersion; localization_away_comap_range and the DVR prime dichotomy identify its range with the complement of the closed point. The first step and hV identify this range with the inverse image of V. Lift the composite Spec K -> N through V using IsOpenImmersion.lift, and apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback to the commuting square and the equality of open ranges.

lean.statement:
theorem cartier_stalk_punctured_complement
    {N : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian N] (V : N.Opens)
    (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N) (hD : IsIntegral D)
    (hj : IsEffectiveCartierCenter j) (hV : ∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j)
    (η : D) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    [IsDomain (N.presheaf.stalk (j η))]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (N.presheaf.stalk (j η))] :
    let R := N.presheaf.stalk (j η)
    ∃ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing R)) ⟶ V.toScheme,
      IsPullback t (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (FractionRing R))))
        V.ι (N.fromSpecStalk (j η))
